page.title: XBTF Campaign
page.t: All systems are go, comms? They are online loud and clear. Medic? Vital signs are good and normal. Acknowledged. All stations stand by for prototype test procedures. Ok, X-Pilot lets do this standard procedures from the top.

First, the basic acceleration/decele ration run to gauge the engine propulsion capacity. Initiate acceleration by pressing the accelerator button or use the throttle control in your controller. Do not attempt to touch any other controls in your accelerator. In order to conclude the test, you need to accelerate to maximum velocity. Ready? Count down to acceleration. 3, 2, 1, accelerate.

Nice work, Pilot. We have our readings, and we can proceed to the next step.Commence deceleration by pressing your deceleration button or use the throttle control in your controller.Count down to deceleration.3, 2, 1, decelerate.

Well done pilot. That concludes Phase 1 of our test procedures.The next test is basic maneuvering and navigation.It's designed to make the pilot feel comfortable with the steering and to obtain physical feedback of the usability of the control design.

This craft is equipped with a three-axis control device.This allows you to steer the craft up, down sideways and to rotate it counterclockwise and clockwise.All these controls are of course also available through your joystick, where applicable.Feel free to try out the controls while we prepare our monitoring equipment for the test.We will commence with the actual maneuvering procedures in 60 seconds.
